evidence.pass: All edges verified: editor-page→drafts-service expects saveDraft(listDraft/deleteDraft) matching drafts-service signatures. editor-page→posts-service expects createPost/updatePost matching posts-service exports. drafts-service→drafts-cloud sends action:'save'/'list'/'delete' matching cloud function switch cases. posts-service→posts-cloud sends action:'update' matching new case. All type signatures consistent.

All 6 boundaries covered: BC-001 (edit conflict) → last-write-wins in posts-cloud update. BC-002 (draft data loss) → FM-ED04 emergency save + FM-DS01 offline fallback. BC-003 (edit permission) → FM-PC02 + FM-DF03 ownership checks. BC-004 (draft limit) → FM-DC01 + FM-DF01 cap enforcement. BC-005 (publish clears draft) → editor-page post-submit flow. BC-006 (char limits) → FM-ED02 client validation + cloud re-validation.

Clean layered architecture: ADAPTER (editor/drafts/my-posts pages) → SERVICE (drafts-service/posts-service) → SERVICE (cloud functions) → ENTITY (collections). No ADAPTER→ENTITY bypass. Each hop is exactly one level.

Dependency graph is a DAG. Key flows: drafts-page → editor-page (navigation, not dependency edge — not in graph). editor-page → drafts-service → drafts-cloud → drafts-collection (linear). editor-page → posts-service → posts-cloud → posts-collection (linear). No cycles.

All 9 modules have extension_points and sealed_points. Key: EditorMode is open for new modes, sealed for the three core modes. IDraft is open for new fields (images, tags), sealed for core identity fields. posts-cloud update is open for future image attachments, sealed for auth requirement.

All 14 failure modes have complete propagation chains. Example: FM-ED01 (unauthorized edit) → posts-cloud returns FORBIDDEN → posts-service throws CloudCallError → editor catches → error toast → redirect to create mode. FM-DS01 (network failure) → drafts-service falls back to local storage → editor shows offline indicator. No unhandled failure paths.

State ownership clear: drafts-collection owns all draft records (sole writer: drafts-cloud). posts collection owned by posts-cloud (reads + writes). editor-page owns its UI state (title, content, categoryId, mode, draftId, isDirty). drafts-page owns its list state. No ambiguous ownership.

Design follows research recommendation: local-first write → async cloud sync. Auto-save with debounce aligns with industry standard (2s debounce). Multiple draft support with cloud storage for cross-device access matches research findings. Rejects real-time collaborative editing (out of scope for BBS) in favor of last-write-wins simplicity — conscious deviation documented.

All 14 failure modes across all module specs have at least one test contract. 14 test contracts total: 5 UNIT, 9 INTEGRATION. 6 contracts reference boundary conditions. No failure mode lacks a test contract.
